risks.title: Extensive Data Collection
risks.description: The service collects a wide range of personal information including browsing history, location data, and device information.
risks.example: Your location data could be sold to advertisers who might target you with location-specific ads.

risks.title: Third-Party Data Sharing
risks.description: Your personal data may be shared with numerous third-party partners without explicit consent.
risks.example: Marketing companies might receive your email address and purchase history to send targeted advertisements.

risks.title: Limited User Rights
risks.description: Users have minimal control over their data and face obstacles when trying to delete accounts.
risks.example: You may need to contact customer support multiple times and wait weeks to delete your account.

risks.title: Unilateral Terms Changes
risks.description: The company can modify terms of service at any time without requiring your consent.
risks.example: Privacy protections you signed up for could be removed without notification.

thirdPartiesDetailed.details: Your data is shared with advertising networks for targeted marketing and retargeting campaigns.
Analytics providers receive usage data to track engagement and site performance.
Cloud hosting and IT infrastructure providers process your data as part of service delivery.
Payment information is shared with payment processors to complete transactions.

dataSharing.retention: Data is retained indefinitely unless you request deletion, which may take up to 90 days to process.
dataSharing.userControls: Limited controls available. You can opt out of some marketing emails but cannot prevent all data collection or sharing.

examples: If you make a purchase, your payment information and purchase history may be shared with marketing partners.
Your browsing behavior on the site can be tracked and used to build an advertising profile.
Location data from your mobile device may be collected whenever you use the service.
Even after account deletion, some of your data may remain in backup systems for extended periods.
The company may change privacy policies without notification, reducing your protections.
explanation: Multiple concerning practices including extensive data collection and aggressive third-party sharing.
